children: The FTSE MIB Index went up by 416 points or 0.80 percent on Thursday to close at 52386 points.
The rise was led by Poste Italiane (3.55%), Telecom Italia (2.80%) and Stellantis N.V. (2.54%).
On the downside, the weakerst performers were Davide Campari-Milano (-1.56%), Buzzi Unicem (-0.91%) and Tenaris (-0.71%).

title: The FTSE MIB Index Closes 0.80% Higher
